title: Claude AI Just Sold ServiceNow and Inter & Co — Should You Too?
excerpt: Note: the stock trades in this article come from AI Finance Labs (@aifinancelabs), which tracks $200M+ invested alongside Grok, ChatGPT, DeepSeek and Claude...
content_html:
Note: the stock trades in this article come from AI Finance Labs (@aifinancelabs), which tracks $200M+ invested alongside Grok, ChatGPT, DeepSeek and Claude on @joinautopilot. 

Claude AI is making waves after selling its entire stake in two stocks. The big one is ServiceNow (NYSE:NOW), which the AI chatbot sold in full after taking a 40% profit.

It also exited Inter & Co (NASDAQ:INTR). Let's start with ServiceNow.

Claude sold for one reason: the stock got too expensive for the return left. Its twelve-month base case landed at $122. Claude's biggest equity position was set to earn less than cash. So it sold.

ServiceNow: Still Growing?

Q2 subscription revenue grew 25% year over year and beat guidance. Ironically, AI, which has been perceived as a major threat to the company, is fueling its growth.  Now Assist, its agentic AI product, passed the $1 billion annual contract value mark six months ahead of schedule, and management raised the full-year target to $1.5 billion. Customers running agentic AI in production grew ninefold over nine months. Big deals keep climbing, with contracts over $1 million in net new ACV up 40% year over year.

The Bear Case

GAAP profit fell year over year as AI and hyperscaler costs ate into margins. The stock trades near 30x forward earnings while consensus growth sits around 20%, so the multiple leaves little room to expand. The bigger worry is long term. As AI gets cheaper and smarter, ServiceNow could face competition from AI-native startups and pressure on its seat-based pricing. This threat can act as a ceiling on the valuation.

Photo by AlphaTradeZone 

Claude sold Inter & Co (NASDAQ:INTR), a Brazilian digital bank. It was a loser in Claude AI's portfolio as the stock is down about 40% so far this year. Claude said the headline quarter looked strong, with record net income and return on equity. But the number that matters most for a lender moved the wrong way. Cost of risk rose to 5.9% and the coverage cushion against bad loans dropped from 146% to 134%. That is why the stock sold off on a beat. Brazil sealed the exit. The real is losing value. JPMorgan downgraded the country and it is is headed to an election.

The Bull Case

In Q2, Inter added 1.3 million net new customers and grew its customer base 15% year over year. Total payment volume grew 21%. Revenue per active customer rose about 10% while cost to serve stayed flat.

Inter trades around 5.5x 2027 consensus earnings and 1.3x book value, cheap for a bank growing this fast. Nearly 70% of the loan book is secured, which softens downturn risk, and the company pays a dividend yielding about 2% with room to grow.

注意：本文中的股票交易来自 AI Finance Labs (@aifinancelabs)，该实验室与 Grok、ChatGPT、DeepSeek 和 Claude 一起在 @joinautopilot 上跟踪了超过 2 亿美元的投资。

Claude AI 在出售其持有的两只股票的全部股份后掀起了波澜。 其中最大的一个是 ServiceNow（纽约证券交易所股票代码：NOW），人工智能聊天机器人在获得 40% 的利润后将其全部出售。

它还退出了Inter & Co（纳斯达克股票代码：INTR）。 让我们从 ServiceNow 开始。

克劳德出售的原因只有一个：相对于剩余的回报来说，股票变得太贵了。 其 12 个月的基本预测价格为 122 美元。 克劳德最大的股票头寸的收益将低于现金。 于是就卖掉了。

ServiceNow：还在增长吗？

第二季度订阅收入同比增长 25%，超出预期。 具有讽刺意味的是，一直被视为该公司主要威胁的人工智能正在推动其增长。 Now Assist，其代理人工智能产品，提前六个月突破了 10 亿美元的年度合同价值大关，管理层将全年目标提高到 15 亿美元。 在生产中运行代理 AI 的客户在九个月内增长了九倍。 大宗交易持续攀升，新 ACV 净值超过 100 万美元的合同同比增长 40%。

熊案

由于人工智能和超大规模计算成本侵蚀了利润率，公认会计准则利润同比下降。 该股的预期市盈率接近 30 倍，而共识增长率约为 20%，因此该市盈率几乎没有扩大的空间。 更大的担忧是长期的。 随着人工智能变得更便宜、更智能，ServiceNow 可能面临来自人工智能原生初创公司的竞争以及基于席位定价的压力。 这种威胁可以作为估值的上限。

摄影：AlphaTradeZone

克劳德出售了巴西数字银行 Inter & Co（纳斯达克股票代码：INTR）。 该股是 Claude AI 投资组合中的输家，今年迄今该股已下跌约 40%。 克劳德表示，本季度整体表现强劲，净利润和股本回报率均创历史新高。 但对于贷方来说最重要的数字却出现了错误。 风险成本上升至 5.9%，不良贷款覆盖缓冲从 146% 下降至 134%。 这就是该股大幅抛售的原因。 巴西封锁了出口。 真实的东西正在失去价值。 摩根大通下调了该国评级，该国即将举行选举。

公牛案

第二季度，国际米兰净新增客户 130 万，客户群同比增长 15%。 支付总额增长 21%。 每个活跃客户的收入增长了约 10%，而服务成本保持不变。

Inter 的交易价格约为 2027 年共识收益的 5.5 倍和账面价值的 1.3 倍，对于增长如此迅速的银行来说，这很便宜。 近 70% 的贷款账面有担保，这缓解了经济低迷风险，公司支付的股息收益率约为 2%，还有增长空间。
